asset.label: British Columbia Transmission Corporation — Full name, 2004 annual report

asset.dateNote: Publication date, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: The green flag-shaped grid symbol beside “British Columbia Transmission” over “CORPORATION™” — the same drawing as the January 2006 service-plan JPEG (an overlay of the two agrees in outline), as vector paths. The 2005 Annual Report repeats it as vectors.

asset.label: British Columbia Development Corporation — The Province’s BC and flag, 1985 (rebuilt)
asset.dateNote: The report’s year, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: The Province’s BC Flag Symbol, horizontal, in one ink, as BCDC printed it under its name in its 1985 annual report.
asset.fidelityNote: Put together from the gallery’s own flag artwork (src/assets/flagMark.js, one-ink palette) and its outlined Arial/Helvetica-metric “BC” (the repo’s flag renderer, src/flag/renderFlagSvg.js); the flag’s size and place beside the letters are fitted to the microfiche scan by overlap (IoU 0.68; the scan is blurred and fills in the flag’s white separations). asset.label: Urban Transit Authority — Double arrow, 1980 (rebuilt)
asset.publisher: Capital Region Transit System / Urban Transit Authority
asset.sourceLocator: The Daily Colonist, 1 July 1980, printed page 12; Dominion Day bus-service advertisement, bottom left
asset.dateNote: The advertisement’s date, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: The double-arrow symbol: two arrowheads, one pointing left above a white bar and its half-turn below, printed in black.
asset.fidelityNote: Two polygons of 45° and horizontal edges, the lower a half-turn of the upper, their eight dimensions fitted to the 235 × 245 scan by overlap (IoU 0.97). No tracing. Black is the newspaper’s ink, not a known brand colour.

asset.label: Capital Regional District / Urban Transit Authority signature, 1980 (rebuilt)
asset.publisher: Capital Region Transit System / Urban Transit Authority
asset.sourceLocator: The Daily Colonist, 1 July 1980, printed page 12; Dominion Day bus-service advertisement, bottom left
asset.dateNote: The advertisement’s date, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: “Capital Regional District” at left, the double arrow, “Urban Transit Authority” at right, as the shared regional-service signature printed them. The advertisement’s grey halftone bands and its “6-28” code are left out.
asset.fidelityNote: Arrow drawn as in the arrow-only rebuild and fitted to this scan; the two lines are Nimbus Sans Bold (a Helvetica Bold clone) outlines, size, baseline and tracking fitted by overlap. The original typeface is taken to be Helvetica Bold but is not verified.

asset.label: Urban Transit Authority — Signature after the 2020 Commons drawing (vector)
asset.dateNote: The drawing is a 2020 third-party reconstruction; it carries no historical date.
asset.notes: The white double arrow and “Urban Transit / Authority” on an orange panel, as the 2020 Commons drawing sets them. A vector copy of a third-party reconstruction, not of a contemporary original; the orange panel is that drawing’s.
asset.fidelityNote: The arrow is the same 45° construction fitted to the PNG (IoU ≈ 1.00); the lines are Nimbus Sans Regular outlines fitted by overlap (combined IoU 0.92). The orange (#d54d12) is the PNG’s. Nothing here is evidence of the 1978–82 originals.

asset.label: Land and Water British Columbia Inc. — LWBC lockup, 2004 (rebuilt)
asset.publisher: Land and Water British Columbia Inc.
asset.sourceLocator: Fitted to the colour image on the cover of the 2004/05 Annual Report (PDF page 1, 371 × 180 JPEG); the target is the cover of the 2003/04 financial statements (PDF page 1)
asset.dateNote: The financial statements’ year; the colour reference is the 2004/05 report. Not an adoption date.
asset.notes: The square emblem — a white triangle cut from an olive square, a teal sun, three bands of water — beside “LWBC” in teal over “LAND AND WATER / BRITISH COLUMBIA INC.” in black.
asset.fidelityNote: Square, triangle and sun are constructed shapes; the water bands are cubic curves of constant thickness; all fitted by overlap (IoU 0.98–0.99 for square and sun, 0.80–0.90 for the bands). Lettering is P052 Bold (a Palatino clone) outlines, spacing fitted per letter; the original serif is not identified (IoU 0.67–0.75). Colours are medians sampled from the 2004/05 JPEG: approximations. The greyscale 2003/04 scan shows the bands heavier and more evenly weighted than the colour cover.

asset.label: BC Assets and Land Corporation — Letterhead name, 1999 (rebuilt)
asset.publisher: British Columbia Assets and Land Corporation
asset.dateNote: The letter’s date, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: “British Columbia / Assets and Land Corporation” in light italic on two lines, as the 1999 letterhead sets it. The letterhead’s vertical rule, outside the held crop, is not drawn.

asset.label: BCRIC — Green wordmark, 1979 (rebuilt)
asset.dateNote: The brochure’s date, not an adoption date.
asset.fidelityNote: Set in Gelasio Bold outlines (an OFL face metric-compatible with Georgia), the closest of ten bold serifs tried (IoU 0.77); letter positions fitted to the scan. The original typeface is not identified, and the serifs and the R’s leg differ in detail. The green (#259d51) is sampled from the scan: an approximation.

asset.label: Expo 86 — Stacked symbol, after the 1982 trademark drawing (rebuilt)
asset.dateNote: The record’s filing date, not the start of use.
asset.notes: “EXPO” over the 86 of three interlocking rings and a diagonal stroke, as the 1982 official-mark drawing draws it — heavier than the Commons rendition already held.
asset.fidelityNote: Rings are elliptical annuli, the 6’s stroke a bar, the EXPO letters round-ended monoline strokes (capsules and rings); every dimension fitted to the 613 × 753 drawing by overlap (IoU 0.97). Drawn with true arcs; no tracing, no font.

asset.label: Expo 86 — Horizontal wordmark, 1986 (rebuilt)
asset.dateNote: The leaflet’s copyright year, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: “EXPO 86” in heavy round-ended letters, white as knocked out of the leaflet’s red. The ™ is left out.
asset.fidelityNote: Letters built from round-ended strokes and elliptical rings (the 8 two rings, the 6 a ring and a stroke), every dimension fitted to the leaflet crop by overlap (IoU 0.95). No font, no tracing. The red is the leaflet’s, not part of the mark.
